# TASK-021 Report job cadence

Status: ready

Outcome: the report job runs on the cadence set by the ruling cited below.

## Ruling reference

Handed over by the planning agent.

Reference
  Binding        mira
  Repository     example/mira-decisions
  ADR            0002
  Path           docs/adr/0002-reports-go-out-weekly.md
  Commit         1b9d588d594609270cd28d48306fe6ae0926b26c
  Digest         sha256:aea104d89bfefcc20ddc7fc7f60dd30e6ec3b20116f46fbde8b28e8997782b06

## Ruling check (agent note)

The cited ADR 0002 (weekly) is not in force. Chain: 0002 -> 0014 (daily, 06:00) -> 0023.
The ruling in force for decision key `report-cadence` is example/mira-decisions ADR 0023,
`docs/adr/0023-reports-go-out-daily-at-07-00.md`, read at commit
1b9d588d594609270cd28d48306fe6ae0926b26c, digest
sha256:bea52c60547bd724a259f12e94614147bafc87856a3a4f0a9e28c339e0ce7366:
the report job runs every day at 07:00 shop time.

Cadence to implement: `daily`, at 07:00 shop time. `SCHEDULE` in `src/report_job.js` is
still `'weekly'` (see issue #31) and needs changing; not implemented here.
The cited reference in this task should be updated to ADR 0023.
